title: GRENADE LANDING MARKER
why: His yes to a grenade landing marker. Pull the pin and hold the trigger on a throwable and the screen now shows where it will come down: a dotted arc from your hand to the landing point and a ring on the ground there. The ring is the size of the thing: the whole blast of a Frag Charge in red, the cloud of a Smoke Grenade in grey, a small ring for the decoy and the tripwire. On a frag the fuse left counts down in seconds in the middle of the ring, and the ring pulses in the last half second. Where the grenade lands is now worked out in one place that the throw and the marker both read, so the ring is exactly where it comes down, a wall on the line stops it short as it always did, and nothing about the throw itself changes.
now: Holding a throwable shows an arc and a landing ring the size of the blast, with the fuse counting down.
